challenges: Newness by recorded Meeting order differs from actual reservation/upload chronology. English says newest but does not specify event; documented CQ1 operational context must independently justify the interpretation.
Validation CQ1-5 Samsung lookup is not design CQ1-5 status lookup; group classification may be justified by requested Tdoc list, but numbering alone is insufficient.
A later comment says always DESC except explicit request while the actual table explicitly has secondary ASC; preserve the source tension.
Whole-domain missing/conflicting sort keys remain unknown; do not pick min/max Meeting or Agenda or exclude unknown rows.
